strings.MLI_idea_keitas_leadership_desc:
Given the circumstances, elections in Mali could not have gone better. Modibo Keïta is Mali's first- and thus far only- President, elected by the will of the people. Keïta's own mandate is a particular unique blend of socialist ideology and more practical methods of maintaining control.

Mali is divided between those who hold up Pan-African ideals and seek to align the nation with Cameroon, and the traditionalists who wish to preserve Mali's sovereignty. Keïta walks a thin line, but if he can hold the country together, Mali will emerge on the other side all the stronger.
strings.MLI_idea_traore_problem_desc:
Though President Keïta was chosen by the people, not all of the people have faith in the leader of the young country. All the same, these detractors are by and large, nothing to worry about. Jealous ingrates and incompetents, with a glaring exception.

Moussa Traoré is a young military officer who has the ear of much of Mali's military. Rumor and fearmongering about puppeteers in Cameroon run rampant among the ranks, and no doubt, he is looking to foreign capital to support the possible overthrow of Malian democracy.
